title: One Baltic recognition?
hook: Does Estonia's treaty recognition also prove Latvia's?

knows: A statement about one named entity does not automatically cover its neighbour.
doesNotKnow: Distinguish Russian recognition of Estonia andLatvia in two separate 1920 treaty records.

Signing alone does not establish entry into force; these excerpts establish neither every resident’s wishes, settled borders nor later fulfilment of treaty promises. Modern institutional accounts separately describe Riga’s seizure from Swedish forces and Tallinn’s Swedish-to-Russian troop handover in 1710; Vidzeme’s 1721 settlement is distinct.
